errors.ADMIN_ROLE_CODE_TAKEN: A role with that code already exists. Pick a different code, or edit the existing role.
errors.ADMIN_ROLE_IN_USE: This role is still assigned, so it cannot be deleted. Reassign the accounts that hold it first.
errors.ADMIN_ROLE_IN_USE.assigned: This role is still assigned to {assigned} admin account(s), so it cannot be deleted. Reassign them first.
errors.ADMIN_ROLE_IN_USE.assigned_to_del: This role is still assigned to {deleted} deleted account(s). Restoring one of them restores the role with it, so the role cannot be deleted while they are in the bin.
errors.ADMIN_ROLE_PROTECTED: The "{role}" role is seeded by a module and cannot be deleted. Remove the module to remove its role.
